responsibility: This file implements the interrupt and event-dispatch layer used by the COROUTINES runtime in mc-boot. It manages registered vectors for input file descriptors, output readiness, and timed events; associates priorities and attached payloads with them; maintains pending queues guarded by RTco synchronization; and performs priority-filtered waiting through Selective/RTco select semantics before dispatching ready vectors to a callback, making it the runtime scheduler's interrupt source multiplexer rather than the underlying thread or select wrapper itself.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the implementation side of GRTint: it builds and manages the internal vector records, pending queues, locking, timer bookkeeping, and select-based dispatch loop, whereas gcc/m2/mc-boot/GRTint.h only declares the event-vector API used by coroutine support.
